name: codex-provider-switcher
description: Inspect or switch the active model provider for a Codex task without invoking a model.

interface.shortDescription: Inspect or switch the provider for the current Codex task.
interface.longDescription: Adds explicit provider status and switch commands for one Codex task through Codex Provider Switcher.
defaultPrompt: Use $provider status to show this task's current provider.
Use $provider switch sub2api to switch this task to sub2api.
